svg.aria-label: Package layers, their scope bounds, kinds, and the kit areas
svg.text: Composition layer: where domains define market behavior through composition
Scope bound: the domain or family a package lives under, plus the mechanisms it composes
Scope: one domain, plus the mechanisms it composes
Specialization layer: what a family or domain supplies to be composed
Scope bound: at least one family or domain, plus any mechanism a package's name carries
Scope: one domain, plus the mechanisms in a package's name
Kit layer: reusable capabilities that compose nothing and discover nothing
Scope bound: nothing, or exactly one mechanism, held only by the kit that is that mechanism
Areas, in dependency order: a kit may depend on the bands below its own
Scope: the one mechanism each kit is
Thin clients: contracts and identity only
Core layer: carriers with no internal dependencies
An arrow points from a layer or band to what it may depend on.
